data.narrative:
VVater, a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Kevin Gast, has raised $5.79M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises nine private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) alongside one public comparable (LNZA), though narrow peer-stage alignment remains limited.

Valuation analysis relies primarily on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement. Using total capital raised ($6M) as a proxy for current implied value, this method yields $14.5M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable; while nine same-sector companies exist, none satisfy minimum datapoint thresholds (≥3) when filtered by stage, adjacent-stage, or valuation tier, making sector-wide median comparison uninformative.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $12M to $17M, with a median point of $14M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct seed-stage comparables in the narrow Climate & Energy cohort, limiting cross-validation of the 2.5x multiplier assumption. Subsequent rounds of fundraising, market conditions, and technical milestones will materially influence final valuation outcomes.
